results.notes:
Config: the old hookrisk.toml had no [harness] section and maxFeeBips = 0, so nothing needed copying back onto the new template; the new template drops maxTier and adds failOnInconclusive = false. forge build was cached (only a block.timestamp lint warning). Verdict: the expectation holds exactly — unsupported-hook-abi INFO at line 16, seven unmeasured dimensions, complexity unmeasured, harness skipped for constructor arity, gate passes under the new default. The honesty fix is real and is the demo-worthy result: pre-fix this hook produced zero findings, a fabricated complexity score and a 23/33 bound; post-fix it produces an explicit "did not analyse this contract" and a 28/33 bound.

The residual problem is single and consistent: that honesty lives in the finding body but not in the machine-readable coverage surface or the report's headline. coverage.staticAnalysisSkipped=false with uncoveredFunctions=[] positively asserts full coverage; engines[0].status="ok" with an empty Notes cell; the page opens with bold LOW risk and a green Gate passed; the security plan prescribes "one full audit, no math specialist" off tier:low while the tier is undetermined up to high. A reviewer who reads the headline, the coverage table and the plan — and not the INFO body — walks away with a clean bill.
